On the shared plinth, not a separate adjoining enclosure (cf. Maulvi Jami, batch 4), hence join, like Khwaja Bihari 'adjoining Mian Mir's rauza'. Not taken: the Udasi rows sadh-belo-sadh-belo-island-temple (order traced to Sri Chand), guru-gurpat-mandir-db-80-sirey-ghat (Udasi line; hair 'said to be' Sri Chand's) and khatwari-darbar-shikarpur (his image) share the order only; samadhi-of-maharaja-ranjit-singh carries the Tahli Sahib grant (Tahqiqat p. 679) only as the endowing ruler.
